## Research

- When the Interviewer Becomes Artificial (Sept 2026): Summer internship report on how people perceive and experience AI-led market research interviews. Two-stage qualitative study — 16 adults in the Netherlands across six respondent groups each took an AI-led conversation, then a 19-question reflection interview. Thematic analysis (Braun & Clarke): 31 first-order codes → 8 second-order themes → 4 aggregate themes. Core finding, "Safe to Speak, Not to Judge": people speak more openly to an AI and trust it to record and spot patterns, but not to judge them as individuals without an accountable human. Faculty guide: Dr. Rakesh G Nair.
- IRFC financial performance study (Feb–Mar 2024): BBA project, five-year ratio analysis of Indian Railway Finance Corporation.

## Projects

- [India Election Analysis (Power BI)](https://github.com/arunnn3104-dot/India-Election-Analysis-PowerBI): End-to-end Power BI dashboard on the 2024 Lok Sabha results across 543 constituencies, built on a star schema with advanced DAX
- [Tamil Nadu Assembly election dashboard](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/arun-n-209754294_powerbi-dataanalytics-datavisualization-activity-7461937920623611904-_SLt): Dual-map Power BI dashboard (district → constituency drill-down) with a snowflake model, dynamic DAX KPI header (ISFILTERED, VALUES, TOPN), and a DAX mapping layer that reconciles a legacy 32-district shape file with the current 38-district boundaries
- [AI news briefing pipeline](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/arun-n-209754294_dataengineering-automation-python-activity-7472196911194783744-Vrrt): Automated pipeline that scrapes live RSS feeds, batches items into a single payload, summarises them with Google Gemini, and emails a Markdown morning briefing over SMTP; tested on FIFA World Cup 2026 news
